EDS_SQL.value:
BEGIN TRY
	UPDATE EDS.D30_CUSTOMER
	SET [ISLATEST] = 0
		,[SCD_END_DATE] = (
			SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT
				FROM EDS.D30_ENROLLMENT
				WHERE STATUS = 'Successful'
					AND AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
				) MX_DT_TBL ON DATESK = MX_DT
			)
	FROM EDS.D30_CUSTOMER tgt
	LEFT JOIN EDS.D30_ENROLLMENT src ON src.[CIF_ID] = tgt.[CIF_ID]
		AND src.[STATUS] = 'Successful'
		AND src.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
	LEFT JOIN EDS.ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM SD ON 
		1=1
		AND SD.STATUS_DESC='Active'
	WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1
		AND src.STATUS = 'Successful'
		AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[USERNAME], src.[ACCOUNT_NAME], src.[DEVICE_MODEL], SD.[STATUS_ID], FORMAT(CAST(src.[TRANSACTION_DATE] AS DATETIME) + CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', src.[TRANSACTION_TIME]) AS FLOAT) / 86400, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')))
		<> HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[USERNAME], tgt.[FULL_NAME], tgt.[DEVICE], tgt.[STATUS], FORMAT(tgt.[ENROLLMENT_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')));

	INSERT INTO EDS.D30_CUSTOMER (
		[USERNAME]
		,[FULL_NAME]
		,[CIF_ID]
		,[ENROLLMENT_DATE]
		,[Device]
		,[Device_OS]
		,[SCD_START_DATE]
		,[SCD_END_DATE]
		,[ISACTIVE]
		,[ISLATEST]
		,[BNK_CODE]
		,[SOURCE_CODE]
		,[FILE_NAME]
		,[insert_dttm]
		,[STATUS]
		)
	SELECT DISTINCT
		src.[USERNAME]
		,src.[ACCOUNT_NAME]
		,src.[CIF_ID]
		,CAST(src.[TRANSACTION_DATE] AS DATETIME) + CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', src.[TRANSACTION_TIME]) AS FLOAT) / 86400
		,src.[DEVICE_MODEL]
		,NULL
		,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(src.[FILE_NAME], 12), 8) AS DATE) AS [SCD_START_DATE]
		,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE]
		,1 AS [ISACTIVE]
		,1 AS [ISLATEST]
		,LEFT(src.[FILE_NAME], 5) AS [BNK_CODE]
		,'D30' AS [SOURCE_CODE]
		,src.[FILE_NAME]
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME)
		,SD.[STATUS_ID] AS [STATUS]
	FROM EDS.D30_ENROLLMENT src
	JOIN EDS.ENROLLMENT_STATUS_DIM SD 
		ON	1=1
		AND SD.STATUS_DESC='Active'
	WHERE src.[STATUS] = 'Successful'
		AND src.AS_OF_DATE = CAST('${PROCESS_DATE}' AS DATE)
		AND NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM EDS.D30_CUSTOMER tgt
			WHERE src.[CIF_ID] = tgt.[CIF_ID]
				AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', src.[USERNAME], src.[ACCOUNT_NAME], src.[DEVICE_MODEL], SD.[STATUS_ID], FORMAT(CAST(src.[TRANSACTION_DATE] AS DATETIME) + CAST(DATEDIFF(SECOND, '00:00:00', src.[TRANSACTION_TIME]) AS FLOAT) / 86400, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')))
				= HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', tgt.[USERNAME], tgt.[FULL_NAME], tgt.[DEVICE], tgt.[STATUS], FORMAT(tgt.[ENROLLMENT_DATE], 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') ))
				AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1
			);
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
	THROW 51000
		,@msg
		,1;
END CATCH
